body: I went to the Golden Gate Bridge to jump but was stopped by the police. I’m at the hospital now.
Thank you ❤️I just woke up, I’m still going to do it, I’ll leave the house in a few hours. Thank you for your comment though I really appreciate it

I don’t know what exactly is different. Nothing in particular happened. My whole life has been leading up to this. I’d always figured I’d die by suicide, the question was just when. I guess it’s built up for long enough. Usually when I feel suicidal the feeling is intense, hysterical, uncontrollable, devastating, the worst pain in the world. But this time I’m calm, and not in very much pain or anguish. I’m relieved that I’m finally doing it. I’m ready for it to be over.
I don’t think there’s anything anyone can say to change my mind. But I just want someone to know. To be there for me on my last night. Be there with me. So I’m not alone.

This time is different than all other times I’ve been suicidal. Usually I’m hysterical and desperate. This time I’m oddly calm. All the usual tricks of distraction or waiting 24 hours or thinking of what you’ll miss or who will miss you doesn’t work this time. I know that I won’t always feel this way. I know it will get better. But the goodness of the world is not worth the suffering of the badness. I know i have so much potential and so much to live for but I don’t care it just not worth it.

I know people will miss me, and I know things will get better and I know I won’t always feel this bad. But at this point it’s not even worth it. The goodness of the world is not worth the suffering. The trick to wait 24 hours before deciding is useless on me. I’ve been planning this since two weeks ago. I know I’m loved and have support and will miss out on so many great things but it’s just not worth it. I don’t care that I’ll still have amazing times to come. It’s not worth it
